name: Finn
summary: A lot of things, I only figure out halfway through writing them down.
intro: I'm Finn, in Beijing. I write long essays and build small tools for myself, usually for small reasons — NetEase Cloud Music's desktop lyrics looked too ugly, so I hacked an overlay for them, and after enough fixing decided I might as well build my own player.
long_summary: Most of the early essays take words apart: ability, freedom, growth, knowledge — words everyone uses every day, and I wanted to see for myself what they point to. Later I wrote more about where I went and what I made, like the 2026 National Day trip I planned around visa rules, flight prices and a bathtub, or making an animated short with AI. What comes next, honestly, I'm not sure.
beliefs: Naming is compression. Every compression costs an experience.
Splicing and extending are two different operations. Most things called innovation belong to the first.
Empty signifiers bypass meaning and pull directly on emotion. Recognizing them is the prerequisite for immunity.
A subject is not declared into existence. It is trained, under real cost.
The line between invocation and understanding is the most important cognitive divide of this era.
